note: Real broadcast faces mined from the close-up and replay shots the cutter discards. Crowd shots are excluded outright. Identity is not claimed: every entry has player=null.
caveat: Kit colour cannot separate a player from a manager in a suit or a supporter in a replica shirt, so this pool may contain non-players. It is an unattributed strip: nothing here is rendered beside a ranked player.

gates.note: cuts.json carries shot COUNTS but no per-shot ranges, so the segment reason is used as the shot-class proxy

kits.note: k-means over the shoulder patch beneath each detected face; the lowest-chroma cluster (officials, stewards, neutral clothing) is discarded, not treated as a kit

jerseyOCR.reason: no OCR engine installed; a head-and-shoulders close-up rarely shows the number

temporalAdjacency.result: the ranked cohort are anonymous CV tracks from one main-camera clip; a close-up elsewhere in the half cannot be tied to a specific track without a jersey number

entries.identityNote: kit colour constrains the team and nearby commentary gives name candidates; neither identifies the anonymous CV track this deck ranks, so the crop is NOT attached to a ranked player
